host.description: Paulo Morais — Your Own Workout offers personal and private training, small-group training, online training and osteopathy in Lisbon. Online training supports people in Portugal, the European Union and Portuguese-, English- and Spanish-speaking countries. Oncology and post-cancer training are part of this adapted exercise offering.
